items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And there was another fine tenor player named Johnny Beradino. He ended up being a card dealer in one of the hotels in Vegas. Hah-hah! But he was a very fine saxophone player. He had a great sound. Fine player.

ctx.x: Barney Kessel was around during that time, playing. He hadn't been too long coming around here from Oklahoma.

And there was another fine tenor player named Johnny Beradino. He ended up being a card dealer in one of the hotels in Vegas. Hah-hah! But he was a very fine saxophone player. He had a great sound. Fine player.
We had some fine lady players coming along during that period, like Vi Redd, and Clora(?) Bryant, a trumpet player.
